items.title: Eric Bauza, voice actor behind Bugs Bunny and other Looney Tunes stars, dies at 46
items.brief: Eric Bauza, the voice actor behind the modern-day Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, among other iconic animated characters, has died at age 46, according to his family and official health records.

items.title: Condo sales prices are dropping, but new rules may complicate affordability
